full_details: The almanac says Trinity term ends. You did not go out at noon to see the mules. Field stopped at the foot of the stair, as far as Mistress Ansell allows a caller, and took the book. It has no title. His Holinshed stays lent. In the afternoon you played Titus and were dead by the fourth act. At the tiring-house door Margery had twenty-six shillings in her stair, and Sly would not choose Kent or the west. The book has lain at Clerkenwell since Monday. Tomorrow at ten.
one_sentence: Field took his Italian book back in under a minute, and after Titus you heard Margery's twenty-six shillings and tomorrow's hour.
title: A minute at the stair, and twenty-six shillings
